name: Should I undertake major renovations or focus on minor repairs before selling?

mainEntity.name: Should I undertake major renovations or focus on minor repairs before selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between major renovations and minor repairs depends on your home's condition, budget, and the local market. Minor repairs like fixing leaky faucets, patching holes, and refreshing caulk often have a high ROI and prevent buyers from seeing small issues as red flags. Major renovations carry higher risk and may not always recoup their cost in a quick sale. Your Kelby Contreras agent can help assess which projects are most impactful for buyers in your specific Broward County neighborhood, ensuring a practical tradeoff between effort and return.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize minor repairs for high ROI and to avoid buyer red flags. Major renovations are riskier. A local agent can help assess impact versus cost.
